nicheFr: bloque-skate et dissuasifs anti-planche à roulettes
descriptionEn: Canadian-built skate stoppers, ledge deterrents, and handrail stops. Engineered for our climate, shipped and installed coast to coast.
descriptionFr: Bloque-skate, dissuasifs de rebords et arrêts de mains courantes fabriqués au Canada. Conçus pour notre climat, livrés et installés d'un océan à l'autre.
_dataMinimumsRationale: Skate-deterrent niche has 35 keywords / 1310 total Canadian monthly volume. Padding to 8 products would force inclusion of zero-volume slugs (the exact failure mode that triggered the 2026-05-02 restructure). Threshold lowered to match validated demand.
_slugIntentRationale: B2B procurement niche: industries are buyer categories (transit authority, municipality, school) not consumer search queries. DataForSEO 2026-05-02 confirmed no <industry> <product> combination has volume in Canada.
_urlPatternRationale: Site uses [slug]/page.tsx mega-route — products, industries, cities, keyword pages all resolve at /<slug>. Nested URL pattern (/products/<slug>) intentionally avoided per V6 archetype.
